text:
Good morning,

I'm attaching a screenshot of the message I sent about the problem described below, so you have the date.

I should say at the start that I'm a bit in the dark about one thing. My partner Clara Bachmann deals with all our payments, and she has been in Portugal looking after her mother since the end of May. Before she left she said she would take care of the June rent "the way we talked about", and that may well mean she paid it into the official deposit account rather than to Birkenrain. She did mention something like that. But I honestly don't know whether she actually did it, and right now I can't reach her properly to ask, and the banking app is in her name.

The reason all this is happening: since 22 May 2026 we have had almost no hot water in our flat at Mattenweg 133 in Baar. Some mornings it runs lukewarm for a minute, then it's cold. Washing means boiling kettles on the stove. On top of that, the boiler cupboard in the hallway makes a loud banging noise at night that wakes us both. For CHF 2230 a month I expect to be able to wash at home.

I've also attached our lease so you can see what we rent and what it's for.

I'd be grateful for advice on what to do next.

Regards,
Chris Zimmermann
